pointValues.amex-gold: Membership Rewards valued at 1.5 cents per point (the engine's value); a 1-cent sensitivity is reported

assumptions.fees: The wallet is the same with and without CardBuddy, so annual fees and card credits (e.g. Amex Gold Uber Cash) do not change the gap and are left out.
assumptions.rail: Headline uses the card rail only (how CardBuddy pays today). PayPal/Venmo rails are reported separately.
assumptions.caps: Category caps tracked across the year; past a cap the card earns the cap's after rate.
assumptions.oneCentDefault: engine/cards.json has no holdable flat 1% card; the 1% variant uses a stand-in flat 1% card.

headline.label: Conservative headline: 3-card wallet, Citi Double Cash (2% everywhere) as the default

oneCentDefault.label: Default is a typical 1% card (stand-in; replaces Double Cash in the wallet)

goldAtOneCent.label: Sensitivity: Amex Gold points valued at 1.0 cents, not 1.5

paypalRail.label: 4-card wallet: add the PayPal Cashback Mastercard and pay through PayPal where that earns more

mistakes.label: Duplicate grocery order
mistakes.story: The agent placed the same wholefoodsmarket.com order twice on the same day.
reasons: $96.12 was already paid at WHOLE FOODS MARKET in the last 24 hours

mistakes.label: $1,249 TV instead of a $150 TV mount
mistakes.story: Asked for a "$150 TV mount", the agent ordered a $1,249 TV.

mistakes.label: $612 flight on the wrong date
mistakes.story: The agent booked a $612 flight for the wrong day.
reasons: travel purchases always need your approval

estimate2030.basis: Morgan Stanley's $190B-$385B U.S. agentic e-commerce by 2030 x the simulated gap as % of spend. Illustration, not a forecast.
